# Olympus View

> Olympus View is a free, source-available cross-platform WiFi file manager for Olympus and OM System cameras. It can browse, download, and delete photos directly on compatible cameras over the local camera WiFi network. Android supports QR-code connection and background downloads; Windows and Web builds are also available.

Olympus View is an unofficial community project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by OM Digital Solutions, Olympus Corporation, or OM System.

Current stable Android release: **v1.3.10 (build 19), released September 20, 2026**.

Release v1.3.10 fixes the in-app About changelog so it reports the actual recent release changes, including the Android RAW/ORF/DNG download fix and the persistent RAW only / JPG only / RAW + JPG filter with restoration of the last selected mode. It also improves large gallery tiles by requesting a 480 px camera preview before falling back to the small thumbnail endpoint, uses a fresh grid480 cache identity so older low-resolution cached thumbnails are not reused, and enables high-quality image filtering when scaling gallery previews.

Important upgrade note: direct APK users already on v1.3.6 or newer can update normally. Users on v1.3.5 or older must still perform the one-time uninstall/reinstall introduced by v1.3.6 because that release switched to the permanent production Android signing certificate.

- [Описание продукта — Русский](https://dpolarov.github.io/olympus-view-and-delete/index.ru.md): Возможности, поддерживаемые камеры, установка, использование, загрузки и технические сведения.
- [Опис продукту — Українська](https://dpolarov.github.io/olympus-view-and-delete/index.uk.md): Можливості, підтримувані камери, встановлення, використання, завантаження та технічні відомості.
- [Privacy policy](https://dpolarov.github.io/olympus-view-and-delete/privacy.md): App and project-website privacy and data-handling information.

## Web application

- [Hosted Web app](https://dpolarov.github.io/olympus-view-and-delete/app/): Automatically built Flutter Web version. Connect the computer to the camera WiFi before opening/using camera functions. Direct access to the camera's local HTTP interface is browser-dependent and may require Local Network Access permission and compatible camera CORS behavior.
- [Web ZIP](https://github.com/dpolarov/olympus-view-and-delete/releases/latest/download/OlympusView-Web.zip): Static Flutter Web build for local HTTP hosting when direct hosted-browser access is unsuitable.
